programs.title: David Jeremiah
programs.desc: In this weekly program, Dr. David Jeremiah delivers practical messages to the congregation at the Shadow Mountain Community Church in San Diego. Also featured is music from the Shadow Mountain Community Church Choir and Orchestra, as well as performances by musical guests that have included Steve Green and Charles Billingsley. Men and women who have been impacted by the Turning Point ministry also share their stories with viewers. During the month of December, "Turning Point" usually features special Christmas programming.

programs.title: Joel Osteen
programs.desc: Author and evangelist Joel Osteen spreads his message of love and hope as he preaches at the 30,000-plus member Lakewood Church in Houston. The program can be seen in more than 100 countries. Osteen urges people to live at their full potential and form a close relationship with God.

programs.title: RateEscape: Stop Overpaying For Cellular
programs.desc: Cut up to half the cost of your monthly cell phone bill; same towers, same coverage, but a lot less money; it sounds great but is it too good to be true?; join myth-busting legend Kari Byron as she takes on Big Wireless to save you money.

programs.title: You're Not Safe Here
programs.desc: After surviving an accident, a young pregnant woman wakes up in the home of an isolated couple who live in the woods. Grateful at first, she soon realizes that her seemingly friendly saviors want her baby for their own.

programs.title: The Man in the Guesthouse
programs.desc: When a young couple find someone to rent out their converted garage, they're happy to have an additional source of income. They soon realize that their lodger may not be the dream tenant they thought he was.

programs.title: I Thought My Husband's Wife Was Dead
programs.desc: Expectant mother Lola Winters seems to have it all: a beautiful home, a dashing husband named Leo, and a thriving restaurant business. However, her world soon comes crashing down when a woman shows up at her doorstep claiming she's married to Leo.

programs.title: My Husband's Baby
programs.desc: A famous couple's life gets turned upside down when a pregnant woman shows up claiming to be carrying the husband's child.

programs.title: Wife Stalker
programs.desc: Joanna's perfect marriage starts to unravel when Piper, the owner of a wellness center, sets her sights on her husband, Leo. Trying to protect her family, Joanna uncovers disturbing secrets from Piper's past -- including two dead spouses.

programs.title: Tempted
programs.desc: A woman with a shadowy past lures a couple to her childhood home, but as secrets unravel, deadly consequences begin to spiral out of control.
